Container.Name: Malwarr
Container.Overview: Malwarr scans your downloads and media library for malware disguised as video files - the classic ".exe renamed with a scene-release filename" trick - plus real signature-based detection via ClamAV. Sits between your download client and Tdarr/your library: watches the downloads folder continuously and sweeps the full media library on a nightly schedule. Flagged files are quarantined, never auto-deleted. Discord webhook notifications on every finding.

Config.Name: Downloads Path
Config.Description: Your download client's completed downloads folder. Scanned continuously.

Config.Name: Media Path
Config.Description: Your media library root. Swept nightly on a configurable schedule.

Config.Name: Quarantine Path
Config.Description: Flagged files are moved here, never deleted. Give it real disk space.

Config.Name: State Path
Config.Description: Persists incremental scan state across restarts.

Config.Name: ClamAV DB Path
Config.Description: Persists ClamAV virus definitions across restarts (avoids ~100MB re-download each time).

Config.Name: Discord Webhook URL
Config.Description: Discord webhook for scan notifications. Leave blank to just log to container console.

Config.Name: Media Scan Start Hour
Config.Description: 24h HH:MM - when the nightly full media sweep starts.

Config.Name: Watch Interval Seconds
Config.Description: How often the downloads folder is checked.

Config.Name: ClamAV Enabled
Config.Description: Set to false to skip ClamAV and use only the lightweight magic-byte/extension check.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: e.g. America/New_York - affects when the nightly sweep fires.
